items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well, one other thing then. Now, when you get to somebody like J.J. Johnson and Be-bop, you're now getting a style which sounds almost like a valve trombone. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah.

ctx.x: The only thing cut a note on the slide is your lip. Only thing. And lifting from one position up to another position with your lip. See, because that horn runs down in degrees and to get that over again, you go back down (inaudible) come back up high, then you come up high again. And as you come up, you can sound like --
Well, one other thing then. Now, when you get to somebody like J.J. Johnson and Be-bop, you're now getting a style which sounds almost like a valve trombone.
